images.title: Next-door angles add to 180°
images.purpose: Shows parallelogram ABCD with angles 30°, 150°, 30° and 150°: next-door angles add to 180° and opposite angles are equal.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One large slanted parallelogram in the centre with its four angles marked in two colours and one sum under it.
images.exact_structure: One parallelogram ABCD in dark outline, leaning right, with the long sides top and bottom, A bottom left, B bottom right, C top right, D top left. The top and bottom sides each carry one identical arrowhead; the two slanting sides each carry two identical arrowheads, showing the parallel pairs. Angle arcs inside the shape: a small teal (#0072B2) arc labelled 30° at A and at C; a larger amber (#E69F00) arc labelled 150° at B and at D. No corner letters are shown. Under the shape, centred, the line 30° + 150° = 180°. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: In a parallelogram next-door angles add to 180°, so opposite angles are equal.
images.description: Shows parallelogram ABCD with angles 30°, 150°, 30° and 150°: next-door angles add to 180° and opposite angles are equal.

image_decisions.why: Two colours for the two angle sizes show the equal opposite angles and the 180° pairs together.
